subject: Game Theory
title: Arms Control Treaties
description: A short lesson to help you apply Arms Control Treaties.

hook.text: The US and USSR each had 30,000 nuclear warheads. Arms control treaties reduced both arsenals by 80%.

buildup.text: Arms control agreements are binding commitments to escape a prisoner's dilemma: both sides disarm together.

discovery.text: Verification is everything. Without inspections, each side fears the other is secretly cheating.

twist.text: Treaties also serve as focal points: they define 'acceptable' arsenals and prevent misinterpretation of intent.

climax.text: The collapse of the INF Treaty in 2019 shows how trust erosion can unravel decades of cooperation.

punchline.text: Trust but verify—the arms control motto.

quiz.question: What makes arms control treaties effective?
